 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Indiana Fever star Sophie Cunningham returned to Missouri with her older sister. The 6-foot-1 guard's busy offseason continues, and her latest move is returning to her collegiate roots at Missouri.
 In a recent Instagram post, Mizzou Women's Basketball shared photos of Cunningham and her sister, Lindsey Cunningham Hudson. The sisters posed for some snaps with the current Tigers squad.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "💛," the post's caption read.
 The 30-year-old also commented on the post, expressing her unwavering support for her alma mater.
 "MIZ!!!" Cunningham wrote.
 Cunningham drew the attention of fans on social media with her latest move.
 "Love you Sophie ♥️" a comment on Instagram read.
 "Sophie is the coolest ever!!!!🙌❤️" another said.
 "@sophie_cham the World's sweetheart ❤️" a user wrote.
 "So many great options for the future, but a Coach Sophie somewhere to help produce the next gen of players would be awesome!" a reaction read.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "Queen of the court 🙌❤️" said another.
 "Awesome ❤️" a fan posted.
 Cunningham played four seasons for the Tigers and set the program's all-time scoring record with 2,187 points.
 She averaged 17.0 points, 5.4 rebounds, and 3.0 assists in 129 career starts, earned three first-team All-SEC selections and became Missouri women's basketball's first AP All-American.
 Cunningham led Mizzou to four consecutive NCAA tournament appearances before she turned pro as the 13th overall pick in the 2019 WNBA Draft.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Her older sister also played for the Tigers, and they were teammates for two seasons.
 Cunningham's ties to Missouri are deep, as her parents, Jim and Paula, also represented the university in football and track and field, respectively.
 As for her WNBA career, Cunningham is facing a pivotal offseason. She is set to enter free agency after her one-year, $665,000 contract with the Fever ended following their first-round playoff exit.
